posts.title: Harrison urges Abbott to limit Hinojosa's powers

posts.body: Less than 24 hours after Gina Hinojosa became governor-elect, Representative Brian Harrison [urged Governor Greg Abbott to convene a special session](https://fox4news.com/news/republican-lawmaker-suggests-abbott-strip-governors-emergency-powers-before-hinojosa-takes-office) to restrict the governor's emergency powers. posts.body: [Gina Hinojosa was elected Texas' first Latina governor](https://www.manilatimes.net/2026/11/04/world/americas-emea/democrat-gina-hinojosa-elected-texas-first-latina-governor-ousts-republican-incumbent-greg-abbott/2461401/amp) on Tuesday, defeating Republican incumbent Greg Abbott. posts.body: [FlashProve](https://techcrunch.com/2026/11/03/anthropic-is-working-on-a-system-to-prove-ai-models-identity/) attaches a cryptographic proof to an AI answer so a user can check that it came from the model named, not a cheaper substitute swapped in behind the scenes. The specification and working code are open source, though Anthropic says there are no plans to deploy the system at any lab yet.

posts.title: Short rests matched long rests for quad growth
posts.excerpt: Published Nov 3, 2026, 9:56 AM: A 2026 experiment matched total repetitions between 20-second and two-minute rests and found no significant difference in quadriceps growth. The short-rest leg needed…
posts.body: Published Nov 3, 2026, 9:56 AM: [A 2026 experiment](https://mindmuscleperfection.com/rest-between-sets-20-seconds-vs-2-minutes-quad-growth/) matched total repetitions between 20-second and two-minute rests and found no significant difference in quadriceps growth. The short-rest leg needed extra sets to reach the same total work, so the result favors matching volume over chasing a shorter timer.

posts.title: Protein before lifting works as well as after
posts.excerpt: The 2025 meta-analysis compared protein taken before versus after resistance training across five studies lasting at least four weeks. Its practical takeaway is to spread protein servings every 3–4…
posts.body: The [2025 meta-analysis](https://www.mensjournal.com/food/protein-before-or-after-lifting-research-challenges-a-common-muscle-building-rule) compared protein taken before versus after resistance training across five studies lasting at least four weeks. Its practical takeaway is to spread protein servings every 3–4 hours across the day, rather than rushing a shake the moment a workout ends.

posts.body: [Altman argued on the October 29 “Cheeky Pint” podcast](https://moneywise.com/news/top-stories/sam-altman-dram-pc-openai) that scarce DRAM belongs in cloud servers running at full tilt rather than in PCs running local AI models.
